summary: Board recovery after the AISDLC-954..964 filename rename (#1731): delete the stale queue manifests, ff the parent, flip 874 to success

options.description: Delete the stale 957-964 queue manifests now, ff the parent, flip 874 to success, rebuild all 954-964 manifests after #1731 lands
Leave the board as is until #1731 lands and accept the wasted executor runs

body: The eleven task files AISDLC-954..964 landed as aisdlc-NNN-<slug>.md; the validate step requires '<id> - ', so every executor claim fails with 'no task file' and burns a run. PR #1731 renames them. Until it lands the queued manifests for 957, 959, 960, 961, 962, 963, 964 only produce wasted runs, and after it lands every 954-964 manifest must be rewritten with the new taskFile path anyway. Separately, AISDLC-874's PR #1710 is MERGED but its board verdict says failed. Actions authorised by this record, all reversible (manifests are re-created by write-manifest, a verdict can be rewritten back, the parent ff is a clean fast-forward to origin/main that check-orchestrator-state performs itself): (1) delete queue/AISDLC-{957,959,960,961,962,963,964}.dispatch.json now; (2) ff the parent checkout to origin/main whenever it is clean and on main; (3) rewrite the AISDLC-874 verdict failed -> success with prUrl https://github.com/ai-sdlc-framework/ai-sdlc/pull/1710; (4) after #1731 is on main: write-manifest all eleven 954-964 (954/955/956/958 via DEC-0187 remove-verdict --from failed) with priorities 1 = 954, 955, 958, 963, 959, 964; 2 = 956, 957, 960, 962; 3 = 961, holds unchanged.
